why_the_three_layers_do_not_apply.explanation: The union components are built only inside the diffusers branch of comfy.controlnet.load_controlnet_state_dict, which is entered when the file carries controlnet_cond_embedding.conv_in.weight. This pack is written in runtime names, so that branch is not taken, the graph is a plain SDXL ControlNet, and the union-only modules are not created. Their absence does not stop generation: the union type embedding is consumed only when a union control type is set, and a plain ControlNet driven by a hint image is a supported use of the same weights.

status: The three declared layers carry union-mode weights that this graph does not instantiate. The pack loads on the HSWQ ControlNet Loader route and generates images; union type selection is the only feature that is not exercised.
